description: UCSB Field Sites Waveform Data (Magnitude 5.5 or larger events) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ekin Gultepe, University of Canterbury (canterbury.ac.nz). The University of California Santa Barbara NEES@UCSB facility consists of permanently instrumented geotechnical test sites designed to improve our understanding of the effects of surface geology on strong ground motion. This data view displays station layout and site information for all eight UCSB permanently instrumented field sites. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (XLS, CSV). Its DOI is 10.4231/d3xp6v349. Keywords: databases ,  Strong Ground Motion Data , Permanently Instrumented Field Sites, geotechnical engineering. Published 2013-03-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
